decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (TON1003 B, TON1004 B, TON1005 B, TON1006 B, TON1007 B, TON1008 B, TON1010 B, TON10012 B, TON10013 B and TON1014 B [received 19 September 2018], and TON1001, TON1002, TON1009 and TON1011 [received 26 April 2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a part first floor rear extension and changes to front and side fenestration of the house.
